title: Grateful Dead Live at Oregon Country Fair on 1982-08-28
lineage: 1st Generation Cassettes (Nakamichi CR-7A)> Tascam DA-3000 (24-bit/96k) > Adobe Audition CC 2022 > TLH flac2496
source: Master Audience Cassettes; 3 x Sennheiser 421 mics > Sony D5; Jim Vita's 1st Generation Cassettes

ai_review.summary: Excellent Sennheiser audience recording with tight bass and superb stereo separation on a classic Dead show
ai_review.review: This release of Jim Vita’s Sennheiser field recording is praised as “most excellent,” featuring tight Phil Lesh bass work and impressive stereo imaging despite the challenges of an outdoor venue. While reviewers don’t single out specific songs, they note that it captures a well‑known performance with high fidelity, making it a valuable addition for collectors.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one detailed review, but it is overwhelmingly positive about both the musical performance and the technical quality of the recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sennheiser field recording noted for tight bass response and good stereo separation in an outdoor setting; overall crisp and well‑balanced.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Classic, well‑known show that flows naturally; no specific issues mentioned.
